request_envelope.time_rule: expires_at must parse and be strictly after created_at
request_envelope.server_rule: remote enqueue overwrites actor_projection_id with authenticated Public session projection_id before validation/hash/storage

remote_enqueue.request: realtime request envelope; actor_projection_id is server-authored from session
remote_enqueue.idempotency: unique installation_id + request_id; same request_id+same canonical envelope returns existing state/result; different canonical envelope returns request_id_conflict
special_rules: table_draft.* requires fresh Local connectivity before enqueue
kind capability is enforced against Public session projection

local_claim.selection: oldest eligible row by id where queued+not expired OR claimed+lease expired
local_claim.pre_claim_expiry: queued rows with expires_at<=UTC now transition to expired and clear lease fields
local_claim.lease_token: 24 random bytes returned as 48 hex chars; only SHA256(token) is stored

local_ack.state_rule: state must be one of realtime terminal states
local_ack.dedupe_rule: if stored state is already terminal, return that stored state with deduplicated=true without rewriting result
local_ack.lease_rule: non-terminal row must be claimed and stored SHA256(lease_token) must match

remote_result.access_rule: session must own actor_projection_id unless capability wildcard *

semantic_invariants: Local revalidates terminal/expiry state before business mutation.
Claim lease expiry permits re-claim, not duplicate business commit.
Business effect is idempotent by request_id.
Client success requires a terminal committed result, not enqueue success.
Ambiguity after transport failure is resolved by result lookup; no surprise commit after expiry.
This state machine is never merged with deferred-safe work.
v3_note: This file captures proven legacy wire semantics for migration. Endpoint names and final V3 version remain draft until producer/consumer implementation and compatibility tests are migrated.
